copy.headline: Kaskimaki's go-ahead goal helps Blues to 5-3 win over Stars
copy.caption: Aleksanteri Kaskimaki’s goal in the third period put the St. Louis Blues ahead for good in a 5-3 victory over the Dallas Stars on Friday afternoon.
